_meta.doc: P3136b — hand-curated, source-confirmed facts per exact couple. Facts in our own words with links; no code copied (CREDITS.md). Merged into couple-sources.json as source 'curated'.

facts.events: Each button = its endpoint (EP1, EP2). Presses arrive as genOnOff (0x0006) Tuya command 0xFD, payload press_type 0=single, 1=double, 2=long. No 0xEF00. Other TS0042 variants (0042TOPlusA) also expose 0xE000.
facts.onOffAttrs: 0x8001 backlight, 0x8002 power-on state, 0x8004 switch mode (not needed for these remotes; never written at pairing)
facts.battery: Do not bind / configure reporting on PowerConfiguration (0x0001): ZHA PR #2288 (TuyaNoBindPowerConfigurationCluster) — reporting setup drains the CR2032. Read passively only.
facts.knownIssues: First press after long sleep can be lost and the LED may blink hourly (#1746, Z2M #8072). Mitigation in both projects: Tuya 'magic packet' (read Basic attributes) at first join only; reported field fix also fresh batteries.
facts.ourImplementation: button_wireless_2: hybrid RX (0xFD + E000 + raw), lib/buttons/ButtonEventRouter FD_PRESS {0:single,1:double,2:long}, skipBatteryReporting, batteryEpOnly 1, lib/zigbee/TuyaMagicPacket.js. Already covered; nothing mandatory at pairing.
